description: The Italian Department of Civil Protection and CNR-IGAG publish the MaGIC seafloor mapping products, with partner contributions including GeoAzur. Existing levels 2, 3 and 4 maps, Porto Torres products and the 473 previously added physiographic/bathymetric component publications are retained. Six additional native publications cover the Castelsardo levels 2/3/4 map, Nizza 50 m contours, Alicudi–Filicudi nominal 200 m grid, programme-wide level-2 morphological units, level-4 critical points and the sheet index. These are complementary or overlapping representations in the source-defined MaGIC-1 hierarchy, not six new geographic tiles. Level-2 lineage explicitly identifies possible seafloor instability hazards to infrastructure. Level 4 flags potential harm to people or structures through expert judgement, without complete risk assessment or event probabilities. The source states that marine/coastal infrastructure inventories are unavailable and maps are unsuitable for navigation. Coverage spans Italian coastal seas and Nizza near France. Added metadata dates are 2016 and 2020, not current observation dates. All six additions declare CC BY 4.0 and public access; the earlier Marsili licence remains unresolved. Native format labels conflict with some abstracts: level 2 says Shapefile but lists TIFF, while the Alicudi grid describes x-y-z text but lists GeoJSON. These conflicts and earlier grid-resolution conflicts remain explicit. Metadata and repository paths provide access; file-use costs and particular simulation applications remain unverified. No files, maps, features or code were read.
